Business Analyst.description: Translates business needs into requirements, analyses data and processes, and builds reports and dashboards for decision makers.

Data Analyst.description: Cleans, analyses and visualises data to answer business questions and track KPIs.

Data Scientist.description: Builds statistical and machine learning models to predict outcomes and generate insights.

Machine Learning Engineer.description: Builds, deploys and maintains machine learning models in production systems.

Data Engineer.description: Designs and builds data pipelines, warehouses and infrastructure that move and store data reliably.

Software Engineer.description: Designs, writes and maintains software applications and services.

Product Manager.description: Owns a product's direction, prioritises features and coordinates engineering, design and business teams.

AI / GenAI Engineer.description: Builds applications on large language models using prompting, RAG and agents.

Risk / Financial Analyst.description: Analyses financial data and models risk to support investment and lending decisions.

Cloud / DevOps Engineer.description: Automates infrastructure, deployments and monitoring on cloud platforms.
